Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the destination as “Augusta” not in Maine (using ~508 miles from Cincinnati and citing I-90), which drastically undercounted the trip distance. This led to too few bottles and a smaller refund. Additionally, the agent applied rounding incorrectly (rounding bottles instead of miles “to the nearest 100”) and assumed a deposit value without confirming Wikipedia, compounding the error.
